brief.headline: Izumrud sinking sparks fleet criticism; Odesa ports hammered
brief.lead: Pro-Kremlin channels celebrated sustained strikes on Odesa port and fuel infrastructure and Kyiv defense plants, but the sinking of the border patrol ship Izumrud triggered unusually sharp criticism of Black Sea Fleet readiness and Russia's technological lag. West & NATO coverage swung notably less negative amid Bulgaria's coalition exit.

developments.title: Border patrol ship Izumrud sunk, fleet readiness slammed
developments.body: Rybar and Two Majors reported the sinking of the Izumrud patrol ship, with multiple posts sharply criticizing Gelendzhik port defenses and Black Sea Fleet readiness. Two Majors extended the critique, claiming Russia technologically lags Ukraine in robotics and AI-guided systems while fielding outdated Soviet weapons — an unusually candid self-criticism from these channels.

developments.title: Sustained strikes on Odesa ports and fuel infrastructure
developments.body: Channels claimed daily strikes on Odesa port terminals, fuel reservoirs (seven tanks per Poddubny) and cargo ships. Kotsnews claimed the Kernel grain export terminal was damaged, blocking shipments to 60 countries. Claims are channel-sourced and unverified; the 20-post volume marks a coordinated deep-strike narrative.

developments.title: Strikes on Kyiv defense plants claimed
developments.body: Two Majors, Poddubny and Kotsnews claimed overnight strikes hit Kyiv military-industrial sites producing missiles and drones, naming contractors Radioizmiritel and Ukr Armo Tech. Damage claims are unconfirmed and channel-sourced.

developments.title: FSB claims foiling SBU drone plot via Europe
developments.body: Rybar, Poddubny, Kotsnews and NgP raZVedka amplified an FSB claim of disrupting an SBU sabotage network smuggling 35 Canadian-made FPV drones disguised as Spanish ceramic tiles through Eastern Europe, with an operator detained. All framing is FSB/channel-sourced.

developments.title: Ukrainian drones hit Salawat refinery in Bashkortostan
developments.body: Two Majors reported a Ukrainian drone strike damaging the Gazprom Neftekhim Salawat refinery complex, causing fires with no casualties reported — a rare negative-sentiment admission of a successful deep strike on Russian territory.

developments.title: Bulgaria exit and French Rafale deal dominate NATO coverage
developments.body: Channels welcomed Bulgaria reportedly leaving the 'coalition of the willing' and rejecting further aid to Ukraine, while warning France agreed to supply 16 Rafale jets and license SCALP/SAMP-T production. NATO exercises in Poland were framed as contingent on a ceasefire, limiting immediate threat.

narrative_watch.title: Rare self-criticism of Russian tech lag
narrative_watch.body: Beyond the Izumrud fallout, Two Majors openly claimed Russia lags Ukraine in robotics and AI-guided systems and fields outdated weaponry — a candid critique worth tracking against the usual triumphalism.

narrative_watch.title: Western strategic distraction with Iran
narrative_watch.body: Multiple channels foreground US-Iran conflict, Trump's strikes on Iran and Iran declaring Starlink a legitimate target — framing Western attention as diverted from Ukraine.

narrative_watch.title: 'Cracks in the coalition' framing
narrative_watch.body: Bulgaria's exit is amplified across channels as evidence the Western coalition backing Ukraine is fracturing, paired with claims of record European Russian LNG imports.

flag_texts.title: West & NATO sentiment jumps +31
flag_texts.body: Coverage stayed net-negative (-19) but improved sharply, driven by celebration of Bulgaria quitting the Ukraine coalition and framing NATO exercises in Poland as ceasefire-dependent and non-imminent.

flag_texts.title: Russia internal sentiment drops 58 points
flag_texts.body: Net fell to +17 as FSB counter-sabotage wins were offset by Leningrad fuel rationing, US Arctic satellite surveillance claims and the Izumrud-related security anxieties.

flag_texts.title: Watchlist topics silent
flag_texts.body: No posts on mobilisation rumours or criticism of Putin today; the day's criticism centered on the navy command and technological lag rather than the political leadership.
